rationale: Builds on the 9x512 reverse-tail best with a surgical recurrence-schedule change: the original iteration-based ramp never activates before the 600s wallclock stop, so the penultimate recurrent tail block trains at 0.35 gain while final exact evaluation runs full recurrence. The embedded script adds a fixed late step-budget ramp from steps 640 to 760 so the quant-aware endgame rehearses the full-gain recurrence used by final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact, with no shape, validation, tokenizer, or print-format changes.
title: Late Budgeted Tail-Gain Rehearsal
